review: Read the complete personal OpenAI/Gemini settings and suites, ConnectionHealthPanel/provider and suite, CaptainKeyesTaskAccess and suite, health projection/memory helpers and their shared suite. The key settings, their tests and connection event constant are unchanged from the public preview (five files). Seven new files are proposed.

Personal keys are submitted only through the explicit native bridge. Password inputs clear before submission, account events clear drafts/state, and generations ignore late results. Key save, read-only model check, managed chat test and optional Gemini diagnostic remain distinct. No real key was read or saved; tests contain named dummy values only.

Connection health separates selected route/purpose, local transport/computer approval, OAuth, fresh authenticated presence, exact task, pairing, runtime binding, catalog and package selection. Presence must be fresh and identity matched; a missing registration alone does not revoke pairing. Health observation does not renew grants, pair or start work. Idle personal presence is unverified, not proof of revocation.

Health memory admits hashes and validated build labels only. Notifications require opt-in and same-account prior evidence, are deduplicated and time bounded, and stay quiet on owner Stop. Tests mock cryptographic hashing and native/HTTP reads; exact native identity is not established by those mocks.

Captain Keyes reads status on mount. Saved configuration and task inspection are explicit, owner matched and schema checked; write-scoped Stop requires an inspected task and an unknown result disables automatic retry. Exact operations, sources, audience, reasoning host, budget and persistent redirect effects are shown for private website review.

Reproduced two late authorization failures after account invalidation/unmount. Added a generation guard before forwarding a returned authorization URL to the native bridge; both regressions and existing authorization test pass. No approval or native/server authority was changed.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no publication, provider key operation, real notification, task mutation, model call or native authorization occurred.

Fifty-four mocked tests in five files qualify selected source behavior. They do not establish installed native custody, provider billing/access, OAuth, real Windows notifications or signed-update acceptance.

ManagedConversationPreview was read as a dependency, but its hook/runtime and full private conversation behavior remain separate source/acceptance work. The unchanged key suites use those canonical dependencies.

Captain Keyes task-selection changes during an outstanding inspect, competing status reads and disconnect finalizer concurrency remain separate qualification; only late authorization dispatch was changed.

Health projection shared contracts/account-policy/native bindings remain separately reviewed inputs. Storage-denied behavior, native-event identity and real browser/account concurrency are not qualified here.
Five intentional support-contact matches inherited from prior candidates remain in the final owner publication review.
